prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity, shippable desktop WEB APPLICATION SCREENSHOT for the existing Chinese product “伴随”. This is a redesign of a personal AI task console, inspired by the task/session overview purpose of botmux, but designed for a person's daily work. Output a large crisp wide landscape screen, approximately 16:10, directly front-on, with NO laptop frame, NO decorative scene, NO perspective.
Primary request: a LARGE TASK BOARD, similar to a precise todo app. The TASKS dominate the whole screen. Default is ALL ROLES, with role filtering. Three generously sized columns clearly labeled exactly “运行中 2”, “未完成 4”, “已完成 2”. Support a compact “看板 / 列表” switch. Do NOT make a chatbot homepage.
Visual direction: refined, quiet, functional, excellent spacing and typography. Warm off-white canvas, white task cards, ink-black type, very subtle pale gray dividers, muted teal active accent matching the existing companion identity; restrained amber for awaiting a decision; muted green completion checks. 12px corner radius, fine strokes, almost no shadow. Readable modern Chinese sans-serif. Dense enough for real daily use, no giant empty hero or oversized KPI widgets.
Layout: slim sidebar roughly 200px with brand “伴随”, selected “全部任务 8”; below a “角色” heading with “秘书 1”, “量化助理 3”, “产品助理 2”, “生活助理 2”, each with a tiny clean geometric avatar. Below are quiet links “对话”, “资料”, “记忆”, “角色管理”. Bottom small “设备在线” status and “找秘书” entry. Main header title “任务看板”, small count “8 项任务”, clear search box “搜索任务”, right “＋ 新任务”. All eight tasks are visible or nearly visible.
Task cards in running: “验证低换手选股假设” / 量化助理 / “正在核对样本和数据口径”; “重做伴随任务看板” / 产品助理 / “正在联调任务状态”. Show an active small indicator and the latest progress line, no invented percentages.
Unfinished cards: “整理周末出行资料” / 生活助理 / amber “等你补充日期”; “补充回测样本” / 量化助理 / “待安排”; “整理悬浮记录交互” / 产品助理 / “待安排”; “招募阅读助理” / 秘书 / small button “查看建议”. Complete cards: “保存本周收藏片段” / 生活助理 / “查看资料”; “整理研究问题清单” / 量化助理 / “查看成果”. Each task shows role, concise current state, small time and unobtrusive more menu. No code, terminal transcript, API IDs, credential UI, graphs, billing, or fake analytics. Preserve exact short Chinese labels, polished alignment and accessible contrast. This is a UI design concept with fictional task data, not a marketing poster.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity Chinese ANDROID PRODUCT INTERACTION DESIGN BOARD for the existing companion product “伴随”, Android capture tool named “记一下”. Large crisp landscape sheet, approximately 16:10, clean warm off-white background, three front-on smartphone screens side by side at equal scale, very thin dark Android bezels. Refined native Android visual language, clear modern Chinese sans-serif, white compact panels, ink-black text, muted teal primary action consistent across screens, small soft corners. NO 3D tilted devices, hands, studio props, giant slogans, or decorative gradients.
Primary requirement: the main entrance is a TINY FLOATING BUBBLE on top of ANY ordinary app, so the user does not need to open a full capture app. The original app must remain visibly present behind the overlay. The floating control must be clearly visible, small, circular/rounded, roughly 42dp, near a screen edge, with a simple note mark and small “记” glyph. It must feel quiet and lightweight.
Screen 1, caption above device exactly “随处轻触”: a fictional 小红书-style post detail page, with an original outdoors landscape image, title “周末轻徒步路线”, short generic body text and the familiar subtle red social app controls. Place the small muted teal “记” floating bubble on the right edge over the post. The underlying reading experience remains almost entirely unobstructed.
Screen 2, caption exactly “展开就能记”: same post remains visible in upper portion, a compact bottom overlay sheet occupying less than half the screen, NOT a full-screen app. Sheet heading “记一下”, close icon, comfortable text field showing “这条路线先留着，周末再安排。”, quiet actions “粘贴” and “加图片”, small hint “先存本机，联网同步”, one clear teal “记下” button. Focus on one tap to summon and quick capture. Show no chat terminal, dashboard, folders, mandatory tagging, login form, or complex navigation.
Screen 3, caption above exactly “后续：读取当前帖子”: future extension concept, same underlying post, compact overlay showing a small status “已授权小红书”, source chip “当前帖子”, neatly extracted title “周末轻徒步路线”, a small thumbnail, three short content bullets “路线安排”, “交通方式”, “装备清单”, optional note field “补充一句…”, and primary button “保存到资料”. This is an explicit future capability preview after a user enables access, not a claim that overlay permission alone can read other apps. Show the capture and provenance clearly, with no continuous background surveillance UI.
Keep the three phone designs coherent and readable, prioritize real usability over decoration. Short Chinese text must be accurately rendered. Bottom of the board a tiny neutral label “交互设计稿 · 示例内容”.
